units.source_text: 冷泉帝在一切艺事中，最感兴味的是绘画。

en.t: Among all the arts, Emperor Reizei was most interested in painting.

units.source_text: 想是由于爱好之故，自己也画得一手好画。

en.t: Perhaps because he loved it so much, he himself was also quite skilled at painting.

units.source_text: 梅壶女御最擅长于绘事，

en.t: The Umetsubo lady-in-waiting was especially accomplished in painting,

units.source_text: 因此帝心向往于她，常常到她院中去，与她一同作画。

en.t: and so the Emperor's heart was drawn to her, and he often went to her apartments to paint with her.

units.source_text: 殿上的青年人中，凡是学画的，皇上必然另眼看待，何况这个美人。

en.t: Among the young courtiers, anyone who studied painting was sure to receive the Emperor's special regard, all the more so this beautiful woman.

units.source_text: 她作画时神情雅致，不拘主题，随意挥洒。

en.t: When she painted, her bearing was graceful; she was not bound by the subject, but let her brush move freely.

units.source_text: 有时斜倚案几，搁笔凝思，姿态十分美妙，

en.t: At times she would lean sideways against the writing table, lay down her brush, and sink into thought, her pose wonderfully beautiful,

units.source_text: 皇上看了深觉可爱，便更加常来梅壶院，比前越发宠幸她了。

en.t: and when the Emperor saw this, he found her deeply charming, visited the Umetsubo apartments even more often, and favored her more than before.

units.source_text: 权中纳言生性是个逞强好胜的人，

en.t: The Gon Chunagon was by nature a proud and competitive man,

units.source_text: 闻得了这消息，大为不平，定要自己女儿不让他人。

en.t: and when he heard this news, he was greatly displeased and resolved that his own daughter would not yield to anyone.

units.source_text: 便召集许多优秀的画家，郑重嘱咐。

en.t: He therefore summoned many outstanding painters and gave them careful instructions.

units.source_text: 并选取各种美妙无比的画材，特备最上等的纸张，

en.t: He also selected all sorts of extraordinarily fine painting materials and specially prepared the highest quality paper,
then had them divide up the work and paint.

units.source_text: 他认为故事画最富趣味，最宜欣赏，

en.t: He believed that narrative paintings were the most engaging and the most pleasing to view,

units.source_text: 便尽量选取美妙动人的题材来叫他们画。

en.t: so he chose as many beautiful and moving subjects as he could and had them paint those.

units.source_text: 此外描写一年内每月的节日、活动和景物的画，也加上特别新颖的题词。

en.t: In addition, for paintings depicting each month's festivals, activities, and scenery throughout the year, he added especially novel inscriptions.

units.source_text: 他把这些画给皇上看了。

en.t: He showed these paintings to the Emperor.
